extension.summary: Full-screen cinema home, Kodi library, responsive film and series rows, and existing source access.
extension.description: A full-screen Kodi-native home theatre with artwork rows, Movies, Series, Anime, search, personal lists, play and source browsing. Built on the existing video add-on; requires no skin fork or background service.
extension.disclaimer: The legacy CP04 fixture catalogue is fictional. The new theatre reads genuine entries only from your Kodi library and existing installed sources. Trakt direct login and automatic English-dub verification are not provided.
